description: Plain-text (substring, not regex) search across project files; the text goes in `pattern`. Default fileTypes ["gd","tscn","cs","gdshader"]; caseSensitive false; maxResults integer >= 1, default 100. Skips hidden entries and .mcp. Returns: matches[] (project-relative file, 1-indexed lineNumber, line), truncated, filesSearched, fileTypes. warnings leads when no file had a searched extension or a path was unreadable. Errors if pattern holds a line break or a parameter is undeclared.

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return, an integer of 1 or more (default: 100)

pattern.description: Plain-text string to search for (required; there is no query or regex parameter)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: search_project
